name: Kodomari Kaoru
source: Joins in the earth route. Master of the wind type guardian Fudou. Was raised in the same orphanage as her best friend Ran. After Ran is kidnapped she joins Yuuko's group to find her.
translation: Joins in the earth route. Master of the wind type guardian Fudou. Was raised in the same orphanage as her best friend Ran. After Ran is kidnapped she joins Yuuko's group to find her.
